_comment: Mapping of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 4 to Rev 5 controls. The mechanical layer in R4ToR5Mapper extracts the authoritative mapping directly from the r5 catalog XML itself — every r5 entry with <status>withdrawn</status> carries an <incorporated-into> list of destinations. So 'incorporated-into' rows on the page are sourced from NIST's own catalog metadata, not curated copy. This file remains useful only for: (a) editorial rationale text overriding the catalog's brief 'Incorporated into X' wording, (b) recording semantic 'evolved' / 'renamed' relationships that don't trigger a withdrawal in the catalog (e.g., r5 keeps the same number but the control was substantially restructured). Curated entries override the mechanical inference for that r4 / r5 pair. Schema is forward-compatible: a future r5-to-r6 mapping would mirror this shape with `r5` and `r6` keys.
source_authoritative: NIST SP 800-53 r5 Annex 4 (Rev 4 to Rev 5 mapping)

_kind_values.unchanged: Control number exists in both revisions; substantive content may have evolved.
_kind_values.evolved: Same number; content significantly revised (e.g., expanded enhancements, restructured statements).
_kind_values.withdrawn: Removed in r5 with no direct replacement; r5 field null.
_kind_values.incorporated-into: r4 content moved into one or more r5 controls; r5 field is the destination.
_kind_values.split-into: r4 control split across multiple r5 controls; use multiple curated entries with the same r4 number.
_kind_values.merged-from: r5 control combines content from multiple r4 controls; use multiple curated entries with the same r5 number.
_kind_values.new-in-r5: r5 control with no predecessor in r4; r4 field null.
